+	var rooms: RefCounted = main.call("_castle_rooms_ref") as RefCounted
+	main.set("day_one_active", false)
+	rooms.call("show_room", "main_hall", false)
+	await _frames(4)
+	main.process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_DISABLED
+	var world: Node2D = main.get("castle_room_world_root") as Node2D
+	var records: Array = main.get("castle_room_door_hotspots") as Array
+	var scratch: Dictionary = main.get("g") as Dictionary
+	var layer: Control = scratch.get("castle_room_door_visual_layer") as Control
+	_check("physical cues have a separate below-character layer",
+		layer != null and layer.z_index == -950)
+	_check("all nine painted doors are registered", records.size() == 9)
+	var origin_position: Vector2 = world.position
+	for record: Dictionary in records:
+		var data: Dictionary = record["data"] as Dictionary
+		var physical_cue: Control = record["cue"] as Control
+		var button: Button = record["button"] as Button
+		_check(String(data["id"]) + " uses its painted family below input",
+			physical_cue.get_parent() == layer and button.get_parent() != layer
+			and String(physical_cue.get("frame_family")) == String(data["frame_family"]))
+		world.position = origin_position
+		rooms.call("_update_hall_portals")
+		var full_size: Vector2 = physical_cue.size
+		# Put the door halfway across either viewport edge without moving input
+		# or the player. The old intersection/rescale path shrank this silhouette.
+		for edge: float in [0.0, 1280.0]:
+			world.position.x += edge - physical_cue.position.x - full_size.x * 0.5
+			rooms.call("_update_hall_portals")
+			_check(String(data["id"]) + " keeps full mask at edge " + str(edge),
+				physical_cue.size.is_equal_approx(full_size) and button.visible
+				and button.size.x >= 112.0 and button.size.y >= 112.0)
+	world.position = origin_position
+	rooms.call("show_room", "bubble_bath", false)
+	_check("hall mask layer hides in a room", not layer.visible)
+	rooms.call("show_room", "main_hall", false)
+	_check("hall mask layer returns with the hall", layer.visible)
+	rooms.call("close")
+	_check("teardown removes transient layer ownership",
+		not scratch.has("castle_room_door_visual_layer"))
+	main.queue_free()
+	await _frames(3)
+
+
 func _act_one_states(current_id: String, completed: Array[String],
 		boss_ready: bool) -> Dictionary:
 	var states: Dictionary = {}
diff --git a/scripts/probe_castle_door_visual_capture.gd b/scripts/probe_castle_door_visual_capture.gd
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..2a8b96bc
--- /dev/null
+++ b/scripts/probe_castle_door_visual_capture.gd
@@ -0,0 +1,223 @@
+extends SceneTree
+## Mobile-renderer visual evidence for every Castle doorway silhouette and cue.
+
+const DoorLanguage := preload("res://scripts/castle_door_language.gd")
+const OUTPUT_DIR := "res://tmp/doorframe-evidence/captures"
+const TARGETS: Array[Dictionary] = [
+	{"id": "opera_hall", "foot": Vector2(1025.0, 620.0),
+		"family": "opera"},
+	{"id": "mermaid_pool", "foot": Vector2(2415.0, 620.0),
+		"family": "small"},
+	{"id": "__royal_hall", "foot": Vector2(3045.0, 620.0),
+		"family": "royal"},
+]
+const SAMPLE_TIMES: Array[float] = [0.0, 1.1, 2.2, 3.3]
+
+var failures := 0
+var output_path := ""
+var capture_main: Node = null
+
+
+func _frames(count: int) -> void:
+	for _index: int in range(count):
+		await process_frame
+
+
+func _check(label: String, passed: bool) -> void:
+	if not passed:
+		failures += 1
+	print("CASTLE_DOOR_VISUAL|%s|%s" % ["OK" if passed else "FAIL", label])
+
+
+func _capture(name: String) -> void:
+	await _frames(2)
+	var unobscured: bool = capture_main.get("_day_one_story_clip") == null \
+		and not bool(capture_main.get("start_menu_active")) and not paused
+	_check("uncovered live hall " + name, unobscured)
+	if not unobscured:
+		return
+	await RenderingServer.frame_post_draw
+	var image: Image = root.get_viewport().get_texture().get_image()
+	var path: String = output_path.path_join(name + ".png")
+	var error: Error = image.save_png(path)
+	_check("capture %s %s" % [name, image.get_size()],
+		not image.is_empty() and error == OK and image.get_size() == Vector2i(1280, 720))
+
+
+func _cue_for(main: Node, target_id: String) -> Control:
+	var records: Array = main.get("castle_room_door_hotspots") as Array
+	for value: Variant in records:
+		var record: Dictionary = value as Dictionary
+		var data: Dictionary = record.get("data", {}) as Dictionary
+		if String(data.get("id", "")) == target_id:
+			return record.get("cue") as Control
+	return null
+
+
+func _silence_all_cues(main: Node) -> void:
+	var records: Array = main.get("castle_room_door_hotspots") as Array
+	for value: Variant in records:
+		var record: Dictionary = value as Dictionary
+		var cue: Control = record.get("cue") as Control
+		if cue != null:
+			cue.call("set_door_state", DoorLanguage.OPEN)
+
+
+func _apply_act_one_sequence(main: Node, current_id: String,
+		completed: Array[String], boss_ready: bool) -> int:
+	var highlighted := 0
+	var records: Array = main.get("castle_room_door_hotspots") as Array
+	for value: Variant in records:
+		var record: Dictionary = value as Dictionary
+		var data: Dictionary = record.get("data", {}) as Dictionary
+		var portal_id: String = String(data.get("id", ""))
+		var state: String = DoorLanguage.resolve_act_one(
+			portal_id, current_id, completed, boss_ready)
+		var cue: Control = record.get("cue") as Control
+		if cue != null:
+			cue.call("set_door_state", state)
+			cue.call("_sync_material")
+			cue.queue_redraw()
+		if DoorLanguage.is_highlighted(state):
+			highlighted += 1
+	return highlighted
+
+
+func _capture_act_one_sequence(main: Node, rooms: RefCounted) -> void:
+	var completed: Array[String] = []
+	for beat_index: int in range(DoorLanguage.ACT_ONE_DESTINATIONS.size()):
+		var current_id: String = DoorLanguage.ACT_ONE_DESTINATIONS[beat_index]
+		var target_foot := Vector2(2415.0, 620.0)
+		var records: Array = main.get("castle_room_door_hotspots") as Array
+		for value: Variant in records:
+			var record: Dictionary = value as Dictionary
+			var data: Dictionary = record.get("data", {}) as Dictionary
+			if String(data.get("id", "")) == current_id:
+				target_foot = data.get("foot", target_foot) as Vector2
+				break
+		main.process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_INHERIT
+		rooms.call("_position_hall_player_at_foot", target_foot, false)
+		await create_timer(1.5).timeout
+		rooms.call("_update_hall_portals")
+		main.process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_DISABLED
+		var highlight_count: int = _apply_act_one_sequence(
+			main, current_id, completed, false)
+		_check("one visual highlight at Act One beat %d" % (beat_index + 1),
+			highlight_count == 1)
+		_check_target_visible(main, current_id)
+		await _capture("sequence_beat_%02d_%s" % [
+			beat_index + 1, current_id])
+		completed.append(current_id)
+	main.process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_INHERIT
+	rooms.call("_position_hall_player_at_foot", Vector2(3045.0, 620.0), false)
+	await create_timer(1.5).timeout
+	rooms.call("_update_hall_portals")
+	main.process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_DISABLED
+	var boss_highlights: int = _apply_act_one_sequence(
+		main, "", completed, true)
+	_check("one visual highlight at Royal Hall handoff", boss_highlights == 1)
+	_check_target_visible(main, DoorLanguage.ROYAL_HALL_ID)
+	await _capture("sequence_beat_05_royal_hall")
+
+
+func _capture_target(main: Node, rooms: RefCounted,
+		target: Dictionary) -> void:
+	var target_id: String = String(target["id"])
+	main.process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_INHERIT
+	rooms.call("_position_hall_player_at_foot",
+		target["foot"] as Vector2, false)
+	await create_timer(1.5).timeout
+	rooms.call("_update_hall_portals")
+	await _frames(2)
+	main.process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_DISABLED
+	_silence_all_cues(main)
+	var cue: Control = _cue_for(main, target_id)
+	_check("cue exists " + target_id, cue != null)
+	if cue == null:
+		return
+	_check_target_visible(main, target_id)
+	_check("frame family " + target_id,
+		String(cue.get("frame_family")) == String(target["family"]))
+	var stable_size: Vector2 = cue.size
+	for state: String in [
+		DoorLanguage.BLOCKED, DoorLanguage.BONUS, DoorLanguage.PLOT]:
+		for sample_index: int in range(SAMPLE_TIMES.size()):
+			cue.call("set_door_state", state)
+			cue.set("motion_time", SAMPLE_TIMES[sample_index])
+			cue.call("_sync_material")
+			cue.queue_redraw()
+			await _capture("%s_%s_%02d" % [
+				target_id.trim_prefix("__"), state, sample_index])
+		cue.call("set_door_state", DoorLanguage.OPEN)
+	_check("full cue size remained stable " + target_id,
+		cue.size.is_equal_approx(stable_size))
+
+
+func _check_target_visible(main: Node, target_id: String) -> void:
+	var cue: Control = _cue_for(main, target_id)
+	var rect: Rect2 = cue.get_global_rect()
+	var clipped: Rect2 = rect.intersection(Rect2(0.0, 0.0, 1280.0, 720.0))
+	_check("target is on screen " + target_id,
+		clipped.get_area() >= rect.get_area() * 0.95)
+
+
+func _run() -> void:
+	output_path = ProjectSettings.globalize_path(OUTPUT_DIR)
+	var dir_error: Error = DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute(output_path)
+	_check("output directory", dir_error == OK)
+	var scene: PackedScene = load("res://scenes/main.tscn") as PackedScene
+	var main: Node = scene.instantiate()
+	capture_main = main
+	root.add_child(main)
+	await _frames(2)
+	if bool(main.get("start_menu_active")):
+		var start_menu: RefCounted = main.call("_start_menu_ref") as RefCounted
+		if start_menu != null:
+			start_menu.call("_dismiss_menu")
+	main.call("_launch_from_start_menu", false)
+	if bool(main.get("intro_active")):
+		main.call("_skip_intro")
+	for _skip: int in range(8):
+		var clip: Node = main.get("_day_one_story_clip") as Node
+		if clip == null:
+			break
+		clip.call("skip")
+		await _frames(2)
+	main.set("day_one_active", false)
+	main.call("_apply_quality", "speedy")
+	root.mode = Window.MODE_WINDOWED
+	root.size = Vector2i(1280, 720)
+	_check("Mobile renderer", RenderingServer.get_current_rendering_method() == "mobile")
+	await _frames(3)
+	main.set("pearl_count", 10)
+	for friend_value: Variant in main.get("friends") as Array:
+		var friend: Dictionary = friend_value as Dictionary
+		friend["found"] = true
+		friend["won"] = true
+	main.set("trophies", 5)
+	main.set("level2_done_once", true)
+	main.call("_enter_level2_now", true, false, false)
+	await _frames(12)
+	main.call("_enter_castle_interior_now", false)
+	await _frames(18)
+	var rooms: RefCounted = main.call("_castle_rooms_ref") as RefCounted
+	_check("Castle controller", rooms != null)
+	if rooms != null:
+		rooms.call("show_room", "main_hall", false)
+		await _frames(10)
+		# Let the real narration caption expire before freezing timed cue fixtures.
+		await create_timer(maxf(float(main.get("msg_timer")) + 0.3, 0.3)).timeout
+		await _frames(2)
+		await _capture("live_hall_before_resolver_fixtures")
+		await _capture_act_one_sequence(main, rooms)
+		for target: Dictionary in TARGETS:
+			await _capture_target(main, rooms, target)
+	main.queue_free()
+	await _frames(3)
+	print("CASTLE_DOOR_VISUAL|DONE|failures=%d|output=%s" % [
+		failures, output_path])
+	quit(1 if failures > 0 else 0)
+
+
+func _init() -> void:
+	call_deferred("_run")
diff --git a/shaders/castle_door_frame_glow.gdshader b/shaders/castle_door_frame_glow.gdshader
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..e415b332
--- /dev/null
+++ b/shaders/castle_door_frame_glow.gdshader
@@ -0,0 +1,144 @@
+shader_type canvas_item;
+render_mode unshaded;
+
+uniform float motion_time = 0.0;
+uniform float frame_family = 0.0;
+uniform float cue_mode = 0.0;
+uniform float cue_alpha = 0.36;
+uniform float feedback_strength = 0.0;
+uniform float shimmer_period = 4.6;
+
+float frame_region(vec2 uv) {
+	if (frame_family < 0.5) {
+		float top = (1.0 - smoothstep(0.37, 0.43, uv.y))
+			* smoothstep(0.03, 0.10, uv.x)
+			* (1.0 - smoothstep(0.89, 0.96, uv.x));
+		float left_post = (1.0 - smoothstep(0.28, 0.33, uv.x))
+			* smoothstep(0.25, 0.31, uv.y);
+		float right_post = smoothstep(0.66, 0.71, uv.x)
+			* (1.0 - smoothstep(0.89, 0.94, uv.x))
+			* smoothstep(0.25, 0.31, uv.y);
+		return max(top, max(left_post, right_post));
+	}
+	if (frame_family < 1.5) {
+		float top = (1.0 - smoothstep(0.28, 0.34, uv.y));
+		float left_post = (1.0 - smoothstep(0.22, 0.27, uv.x))
+			* smoothstep(0.18, 0.24, uv.y);
+		float right_post = smoothstep(0.73, 0.78, uv.x)
+			* smoothstep(0.18, 0.24, uv.y);
+		return max(top, max(left_post, right_post));
+	}
+	float shell_crown = (1.0 - smoothstep(0.19, 0.25, uv.y))
+		* smoothstep(0.18, 0.25, uv.x)
+		* (1.0 - smoothstep(0.75, 0.82, uv.x));
+	float arch = smoothstep(0.12, 0.19, uv.y)
+		* (1.0 - smoothstep(0.33, 0.39, uv.y))
+		* smoothstep(0.03, 0.08, uv.x)
+		* (1.0 - smoothstep(0.92, 0.97, uv.x));
+	float left_column = (1.0 - smoothstep(0.28, 0.33, uv.x))
+		* smoothstep(0.24, 0.30, uv.y)
+		* (1.0 - smoothstep(0.76, 0.81, uv.y));
+	float right_column = smoothstep(0.67, 0.72, uv.x)
+		* smoothstep(0.24, 0.30, uv.y)
+		* (1.0 - smoothstep(0.76, 0.81, uv.y));
+	return max(max(shell_crown, arch), max(left_column, right_column));
+}
+
+float ellipse_mask(vec2 point, vec2 center, vec2 radius) {
+	vec2 normalized = (point - center) / radius;
+	return 1.0 - smoothstep(0.91, 1.02, length(normalized));
+}
+
+float opening_region(vec2 uv) {
+	if (frame_family < 0.5) {
+		float arch = ellipse_mask(uv, vec2(0.50, 0.39), vec2(0.275, 0.19))
+			* (1.0 - smoothstep(0.39, 0.43, uv.y));
+		float body = smoothstep(0.215, 0.245, uv.x)
+			* (1.0 - smoothstep(0.755, 0.785, uv.x))
+			* smoothstep(0.37, 0.41, uv.y)
+			* (1.0 - smoothstep(0.94, 0.985, uv.y));
+		return max(arch, body);
+	}
+	if (frame_family < 1.5) {
+		float arch = ellipse_mask(uv, vec2(0.50, 0.31), vec2(0.345, 0.19))
+			* (1.0 - smoothstep(0.31, 0.36, uv.y));
+		float body = smoothstep(0.145, 0.18, uv.x)
+			* (1.0 - smoothstep(0.82, 0.855, uv.x))
+			* smoothstep(0.28, 0.33, uv.y)
+			* (1.0 - smoothstep(0.94, 0.985, uv.y));
+		return max(arch, body);
+	}
+	float arch = ellipse_mask(uv, vec2(0.50, 0.31), vec2(0.285, 0.16))
+		* (1.0 - smoothstep(0.31, 0.36, uv.y));
+	float body = smoothstep(0.215, 0.255, uv.x)
+		* (1.0 - smoothstep(0.745, 0.785, uv.x))
+		* smoothstep(0.29, 0.34, uv.y)
+		* (1.0 - smoothstep(0.72, 0.77, uv.y));
+	return max(arch, body);
+}
+
+float painted_frame_mask(vec4 sample_color, vec2 uv) {
+	float luma = dot(sample_color.rgb, vec3(0.299, 0.587, 0.114));
+	float warmth = sample_color.r - max(sample_color.g * 0.88,
+		sample_color.b);
+	float pearl_or_gold = smoothstep(0.025, 0.145, warmth)
+		* smoothstep(0.44, 0.76, luma);
+	return pearl_or_gold * frame_region(uv) * sample_color.a;
+}
+
+vec3 rainbow(float hue) {
+	return 0.56 + 0.44 * cos(6.2831853
+		* (hue + vec3(0.00, 0.67, 0.33)));
+}
+
+void fragment() {
+	vec4 vertex_color = COLOR;
+	float opening = opening_region(UV);
+	float drift = 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(UV.y * 24.0 + motion_time * 0.72
+		+ sin(UV.x * 15.0 - motion_time * 0.31) * 1.7);
+	float cross_drift = 0.5 + 0.5 * cos(UV.x * 18.0
+		- motion_time * 0.46 + UV.y * 5.0);
+	vec3 fog_color = mix(vec3(0.105, 0.075, 0.23),
+		vec3(0.39, 0.35, 0.61), drift * 0.42 + cross_drift * 0.18);
+	vec4 fog_result = vec4(fog_color, opening * (0.28 + drift * 0.17 + feedback_strength * 0.10)
+		* vertex_color.a);
+	vec4 source = texture(TEXTURE, UV);
+	float core = painted_frame_mask(source, UV);
+	vec2 spread = TEXTURE_PIXEL_SIZE * 5.0;
+	float halo = core;
+	halo = max(halo, painted_frame_mask(texture(TEXTURE,
+		UV + vec2(spread.x, 0.0)), UV + vec2(spread.x, 0.0)) * 0.34);
+	halo = max(halo, painted_frame_mask(texture(TEXTURE,
+		UV - vec2(spread.x, 0.0)), UV - vec2(spread.x, 0.0)) * 0.34);
+	halo = max(halo, painted_frame_mask(texture(TEXTURE,
+		UV + vec2(0.0, spread.y)), UV + vec2(0.0, spread.y)) * 0.34);
+	halo = max(halo, painted_frame_mask(texture(TEXTURE,
+		UV - vec2(0.0, spread.y)), UV - vec2(0.0, spread.y)) * 0.34);
+
+	float red_pulse = 0.72 + 0.28 * sin(motion_time * 1.427997);
+	vec3 bonus_color = vec3(1.0, 0.025, 0.075) * (0.86 + red_pulse * 0.25);
+	float sweep_position = fract(motion_time / shimmer_period);
+	float sweep_axis = fract(UV.y * 0.84 + UV.x * 0.28);
+	float sweep_distance = abs(fract(sweep_axis - sweep_position + 0.5) - 0.5);
+	float sheen = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.025, 0.115, sweep_distance);
+	vec3 spectral = rainbow(fract(UV.y * 0.74 + UV.x * 0.46
+		- motion_time * 0.11));
+	vec3 plot_color = mix(vec3(1.0, 0.60, 0.065), spectral,
+		sheen * 0.82) * (0.98 + sheen * 0.32);
+	vec3 cue_color = mix(bonus_color, plot_color,
+		step(0.5, cue_mode));
+	float plot_pulse = 0.84 + 0.16 * sin(motion_time * 1.963495);
+	float state_pulse = mix(red_pulse, plot_pulse, step(0.5, cue_mode));
+	float core_strength = mix(0.64, 0.68 + sheen * 0.24,
+		step(0.5, cue_mode));
+	float final_alpha = max(core * core_strength, halo * 0.22)
+		* (cue_alpha + feedback_strength * 0.10) * state_pulse * vertex_color.a;
+	float plot_gate = step(0.5, cue_mode);
+	float plot_interior_alpha = opening * plot_gate
+		* (0.085 + plot_pulse * 0.035) * vertex_color.a;
+	float combined_alpha = max(final_alpha, plot_interior_alpha);
+	vec3 combined_color = mix(vec3(1.0, 0.60, 0.09), cue_color,
+		final_alpha / max(0.0001, final_alpha + plot_interior_alpha));
+	vec4 highlight_result = vec4(combined_color, combined_alpha);
+	COLOR = mix(highlight_result, fog_result, step(1.5, cue_mode));
+}
